pages.text: Companions take care of themselves with what is in their $(thing)backpack$():$(li)Out of combat and hurt, they eat $(item)food$() until healed.$(li)They drink $(item)Healing$() and $(item)Regeneration$() potions, leaving the empty bottle.$(li)In an emergency they prefer the strongest items, like $(item)golden apples$().

pages.title: Retreat
pages.text: When their health gets low and they carry something to heal with, they $(thing)roll away$(), retreat and eat before returning to the fight.$(br2)Without any food they keep fighting. Out of combat, 5 seconds after any damage (falls and fire too), they also regenerate slowly on their own.
